msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional male fashion model (a man). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia dewe-almeria-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish man in his thirties wearing a beige workwear jacket over a white tee, brown wide trousers and grey retro running sneakers, no logos from the reference, walking at the Cable Inglés iron pier in Almería, Spain, at sunset, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia dewe-almeria-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of a cream suede low sneaker with brown speckles, dark green stripes and a gum sole, no logos or brand names from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#E6E5E1) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia dewe-almeria-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of a grey and silver chunky retro running sneaker, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#E6E5E1) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia dewe-almeria-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a red chunky knit turtleneck jumper with a cream chest band, no text from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#E6E5E1) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia dewe-almeria-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a beige cotton workwear jacket from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#E6E5E1) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
